description: Design a two-player game board that reports as soon as a move completes a row, column, or diagonal. Example 1: on a 3 by 3 board, moves (0,0,1), (0,2,2), (2,2,1), (1,1,2), (2,0,1), (1,0,2), and (2,1,1) make player 1 win on the final move. Example 2: on a 2 by 2 board, moves (0,0,2), (1,1,1), and (0,1,2) make player 2 win. Constraints: board size is positive and each move uses an empty cell within the board.
intuition: Keep signed counts for every row, column, and diagonal; a player wins when one count reaches the board size in magnitude.

brute_force.approach: After each move, scan its entire row, column, and any applicable diagonals.

optimal.approach: Update one row and column count and at most two diagonal counts for each move.

edge_cases: A move on both diagonals updates both diagonal counters.
After a winner is found, subsequent valid moves are not part of the game.
